definitions.full: H4935. mishi מִשְׁעִי noun feminine (? = מִשְׁעִית compare Thes Sm) cleansing , only לְמ רֻחַצְתְּ ׳לֹא Ezek 16:4 thou wast not washed for cleansing (compare ᵑ7 Thes and Add 98 Sm RV and others; ᵑ9 ad salutem , as if from ישׁע ; ᵐ5 omitted, and so Co Be SS, compare Buhl; form strange, and word at best dubious) מִשְׁעוֺל see I. שׁעל .
